autoCleanupNotifyDaysBefore.title: Warn Before Deletion (days)

maxViewsCleanupDays.title: Max-Views Cleanup Delay (days)

accountDeactivationCleanupEnabled.title: Delete Deactivated Accounts' Files
accountDeactivationCleanupEnabled.description: When on, files belonging to a deactivated account are permanently deleted after the delay below. Off by default — deactivation alone never deletes files.

accountDeactivationCleanupDays.title: Deactivation Cleanup Delay (days)
accountDeactivationCleanupDays.description: Days after an account is deactivated before its files are deleted (only when the option above is enabled). Minimum 1.

autoCleanupOrphansEnabled.title: Sweep Orphaned Files
autoCleanupOrphansEnabled.description: When on, runs a two-way sweep that removes database records pointing to missing storage objects and storage objects with no database record. Off by default.

autoCleanupOrphanMinAgeHours.title: Orphan Minimum Age (hours)
autoCleanupOrphanMinAgeHours.description: Only files and objects older than this are considered during the orphan sweep, protecting uploads still in progress. Minimum 1.
